readable_german: Das nicht aus Heimat eingetroffen. NO?A WAU. Festfern, Festfunk A uebergeben Betrieb Montag Abend Polen. S. R. WAU ueberweist Mannschaften Bezkdos des ?K? nach OA?.
meaning: The preceding part ends with equipment; this continuation says it has not arrived from home. Under the stated lost-row hypothesis, the facilities designated FESTFERN and FESTFUNK A hand operation to the Poles on Monday evening, and S. R. WAU transfers personnel to the abbreviated Bezkdos. The opening token, final unit and destination are not identified.

context.limit: The preceding printed part supplies sentence context. The separate p204 A telegram independently describes a Monday handover to the Poles. Neither supplies the missing ciphertext or proves this exact lost-row placement.
